channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Xog-ururin gaar ah: Soomaaliya 16 sano oo aan la helin lacag qaran oo kaash ah, Dollar-ka ayaa noqday lacagta ugu weyn ee lagu kala iibsado
item.description: Xog-ururin gaar ah oo Wartabiye TV ay ku eegtay xaaladda lacagta qaranka, isticmaalka Dollar-ka iyo caqabadaha nidaamka lacag-bixinta Soomaaliya.

item.title: Romario oo mar kale ku baaqay in Ancelotti iscasilo, kaddib guuldarradii Brazil ee Japan
item.description: Halyeeyga kubbadda cagta Brazil, Romario, ayaa mar kale ku adkaystay in tababaraha xulka Brazil, Carlo Ancelotti, uu xilka iska casilo, isagoo ka jawaabay hadal uu Ancelotti ku sheegay inuu Romario si badan u hadlo, sida ay werisay Tuttosport.

item.title: Fernando Alonso oo hoggaamin doona isku dayga Aston Martin ee tartanka Dakar Rally 2027
item.description: Laba jeer horyaalka adduunka ee Formula 1, Fernando Alonso, ayaa hoggaamin doona kooxda Aston Martin ee ka qayb galaysa tartanka Dakar Rally bisha January 2027, sida ay werisay BBC Sport iyo wargeyska Isbaanishka ee AS.

item.title: Mareykanka oo xaqiijiyay baaritaan dambiyeed lagu hayo Megaspeed ee Singapore, kiiska chips-ka Nvidia
item.description: Wasaaradaha Ganacsiga iyo Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii xaqiijiyay inay baaritaan dambiyeed ku wadaan shirkadda adeegyada daruuraha ee Megaspeed, oo fadhigeedu yahay Singapore, kana shakisan yihiin inay jebisay xeerarka xakameynta dhoofinta semiconductor-ka, sida ay werisay wakaaladda Anadolu.

item.title: Kenya: Martha Koome oo dhaarisay 18 xubnood oo cusub, kuna baaqday diyaar-garow hore oo doorashada 2027 ah
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya, Martha Koome, ayaa Talaadadii Nairobi ku dhaarisay 18 xubnood oo ku-meel-gaar ah oo ku biiray Maxkamadda Khilaafaadka Xisbiyada Siyaasadda (PPDT), iyadoo ugu baaqday in si hore loogu diyaar garoobo doorashada guud ee 2027.

item.title: Feeryahanka Ireland ee Lee Reeves oo ku geeriyooday 31 jir, 3 bilood kaddib dhaawac uu ku gaaray ciyaar
item.description: Feeryahanka Irishka ah ee Lee Reeves ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 31 sano, 3 bilood kaddib markii uu dhaawac maskaxeed ku gaaray ciyaar uu la galay Gary Cully, sida ay xaqiijisay shirkadda Queensberry ee qabanqaabisa ciyaaraha feerka.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Laba shirkadood oo diyaaradeed oo Wau dib uga bilaabay howlahooda kaddib khilaafka canshuurta $5
item.description: Shirkadaha diyaaradaha Kush Airlines iyo Arojet Airlines ayaa dib u bilaabay howlahooda magaalada Wau ee gobolka Western Bahr el Ghazal, kaddib markii la hakiyay amar dowlad-goboleed oo ku khasbayay inay rakaab kasta ka qaadaan canshuur $5 ah, sida uu sheegay ururka howl-wadeennada shirkadaha diyaaradaha Koonfur Suudaan.

item.title: Uganda: Ganacsatada Kampala oo dukaamada xiray iyagoo ka dibadbaxaya canshuuraha iyo habka ururinta ee URA
item.description: Ganacsiga magaalada Kampala ayaa Talaadadii, 17 November 2026, ku dhawaad istaagay kaddib markii ganacsato badan ay xireen dukaamadooda, iyagoo ka cabanaya canshuuro ay ku tilmaameen kuwo xad-dhaaf ah iyo habka ay Hay'adda Dakhliga Uganda (URA) u fuliso, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo adkeysay ilaalinta imtixaannada kaddib arday qirtay inuu ku khiyaameeyay AI
item.description: Dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa ku dhawaaqday in la baari doono muraayadaha indhaha ee ardayda gelaysa imtixaanka galitaanka jaamacadaha ee Suneung toddobaadkan, kaddib markii arday helay dhibcaha ugu sarreeya imtixaan qaran uu qirtay inuu ku khiyaameeyay sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Somaliland iyo Ingiriiska oo Hargeysa kaga wada hadlay amniga iyo kordhinta taageerada maaliyadeed
item.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland, Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, oo hadda ah ku-simaha madaxweynaha, ayaa Isniintii Hargeysa kula kulmay masuuliyiin ka socday Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Ingiriiska, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Ciidamada Suudaan oo shan cutub oo cusub u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee xuduudka la leh Itoobiya
item.description: Ciidanka milatariga Suudaan ayaa shan cutub oo si buuxda u qalabeysan u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah (Blue Nile), oo ku yaal koonfur-bari dalka xuduudna la leh Itoobiya, xilli ay dagaallo ka socdaan gobolkaas, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Saddex shaqaale gargaar oo Yei lagu afduubay oo la sii daayay kaddib $2,500 madax furasho
item.description: Booliiska degmada Yei ee gobolka Central Equatoria ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijiyay in saddex shaqaale ah oo ka tirsan hay'ad gargaar caalami ah, oo 9 November qori caaraddiis lagu afduubay, la sii daayay kaddib markii afduubayaashu ay qaateen $2,500, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: RAYE oo hoggaamisay magacaabista Grammy 2027, Beyoncé oo gaartay 100 magacaabis
item.description: Fannaanadda reer Ingiriiska RAYE ayaa helay 11 magacaabis oo ah tirada ugu badan ee abaalmarinta Grammy 2027, halka Beyoncé ay noqotay fannaankii ugu horreeyay taariikhda Grammy ee gaara 100 magacaabis.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Mongolia Ukhnaa Khurelsukh oo iscasilay kaddib eedeymo musuqmaasuq ah oo uu beeniyay
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mongolia, Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, ayaa Talaadadii 17 November ku dhawaaqay inuu xilka ka degayo, kaddib markii xisbiga mucaaradka uu ku eedeeyay musuqmaasuq kuna hanjabay inuu baarlamaanka xilka kaga qaadi doono, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AFP.

item.title: Xavi oo ku tilmaamay shoog guuldarradii 5-0 ee Nederland, warbaahinta Holland oo eedda saartay
item.description: Tababaraha xulka Nederland, Xavi, ayaa guuldarradii 5-0 ee ay kala kulmeen Jarmalka ku tilmaamay shoog, iyadoo ay tahay guuldarradii ugu culus ee xulka tan iyo 1959, halka wargeysyada Holland ay isaga dusha ka saareen eedda.

item.title: Jules Koundé oo la filayo inuu Barcelona ugu soo laabto kulanka Villarreal kaddib dhaawac dheeraaday
item.description: Daafaca Barcelona Jules Koundé ayaa la filayaa in dhakhaatiirta kooxdu ay u oggolaadaan inuu ciyaaro kulanka Villarreal, kaddib markii soo kabashadiisa ay in ka badan hal bil dib u dhacday, sida ay wariyeen wargeysyada AS iyo Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Hakan Fidan: Ruushku ma rabo heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo Badda Madow ah ilaa nabad joogto ah la helo
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, ayaa sheegay in Ruushku uusan oggolaan doonin heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo la xiriira socdaalka maraakiibta Badda Madow, ilaa laga gaaro heshiis nabadeed oo joogto ah oo lala galo Ukraine.

item.title: Japan oo diyaarado dagaal u dirtay kaddib markii laba diyaaradood oo Ruush ah la sheegay inay galeen hawadeeda
item.description: Dowladda Japan ayaa sheegtay in laba diyaaradood oo la rumeysan yahay inay Ruush yihiin ay Talaadadii subax hore ku xadgudbeen hawada dalka agagaarka jasiiradda Okinoshima, taasoo keentay in Tokyo ay diyaarado dagaal u dirto kana gudbiso Moscow cabasho.

item.title: Ukraine oo mar labaad 24 saacadood gudahood weerartay buundada Crimea, socodka gaadiidka oo la joojiyay
item.description: Maamulka Ruushku ku magacaabay Crimea ayaa Talaadadii hakiyay socodka gaadiidka ee buundada Kerch, kadib weerar Ukraine habeennimo ku qaaday, iyadoo warar aan weli la xaqiijin ay sheegayaan in qayb ka mid ah waddada buundada ay badda ku dhacday.

item.title: Ukraine oo Ruushka ku eedeysay inuu beegsaday samatabbixinta Komyshuvakha, halkaas oo 72 qof lagu dilay
item.description: Saraakiisha Ukraine ayaa Ruushka ku eedeeyay inuu weeraro ku qaaday howlgallada samatabbixinta iyo soo saarista meydadka ee tuulada Komyshuvakha, laba toddobaad kadib weerar laba-jeer ah oo halkaas lagu dilay ugu yaraan 72 qof, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ahaa horyaalka adduunka ee feerka, oo ay hay'adda socdaalka Mareykanka ICE ku xirtay Texas
item.description: Feeryahankii hore ee reer Venezuela, Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ku guuleystay horyaalnimada adduunka, ayaa ay xirtay hay'adda socdaalka iyo kastamka Mareykanka (ICE) gobolka Texas, sida ay xaqiijiyeen qareennadiisa.

item.title: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika oo Tanzania u ballanqaaday $26 milyan oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka cimilada
item.description: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB) ayaa Tanzania u ballanqaaday $26 milyan, oo u dhiganta qiyaastii 68.8 bilyan oo shilin, si loo taageero howlaha wax looga qabanayo isbeddelka cimilada, sida ay werisay Daily News oo dowladda Tanzania leedahay.

item.title: Golaha Ammaanka QM oo maanta shir gaar ah ka yeelanaya howlgalka AUSSOM iyo xaaladda Soomaaliya
item.description: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa la filayaa inuu maanta, 17 November, shir gaar ah oo albaabadu u xiran yihiin ka yeesho howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), xilli ay soo dhowdahay dib-u-cusboonaysiinta waqtiga howlgalka ee bisha December.

item.title: NBA: Magic oo Boston ku jebiyay Celtics, Heat oo 128-110 ku garaacay Rockets ka hor kulanka Giannis iyo Bucks
item.description: Orlando Magic ayaa Boston Celtics u gaarsiisay guuldarradoodii ugu horreysay ee gurigooda xilli ciyaareedkan, halka Miami Heat ay 128-110 kaga adkaatay Houston Rockets, iyadoo Giannis Antetokounmpo uu isu diyaarinayo inuu markii ugu horreysay wajaho kooxdiisii hore ee Milwaukee Bucks.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo amar ku siisay hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn inay dib isu diiwaangeliyaan
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Bini'aadannimada iyo Maareynta Masiibooyinka ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa amar ku bixisay in dhammaan hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee gudaha iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ay maraan hubin, dib-u-eegis shaqadooda iyo dib-u-diiwaangelin, iyadoo codsiyada la furayo 20 November.

item.title: Los Angeles Chargers oo 23-20 kaga adkaaday Baltimore Ravens, guushoodii ugu horreysay xilli ciyaareedkan
item.description: Kooxda Los Angeles Chargers ayaa Isniintii habeennimo 23-20 kaga adkaatay Baltimore Ravens garoonka M&T Bank Stadium, taasoo ah guushii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan ka gaaraan horyaalka NFL.

item.title: Tababaraha Koonfur Afrika Pitso Mosimane oo qiray in Harambee Stars ay ka yaabiyeen barbardhacii 2-2 ee Soweto
item.description: Tababaraha xulka Koonfur Afrika, Pitso Mosimane, ayaa qiray in heerka ciyaareed ee xulka Kenya, Harambee Stars, uu la yaabay kulankii isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ee Jimcihii ku dhammaaday 2-2 magaalada Soweto.

item.title: Maraakiib shidaal oo lagu weeraray Marinka Hormuz, drone cabsi ka abuuray goob gaas oo Ciraaq ah
item.description: Maraakiib shidaal qaada ayaa Isniintii lagu weeraray Marinka Hormuz, halka diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn ay dul martay goobta gaaska ee Khor Mor ee waqooyiga Ciraaq, xilli xiisadda u dhaxaysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ay sii socoto.

item.title: Mareykanka oo xeer cusub ku xiraya helitaanka fog ee Shiinaha ee chips-ka AI
item.description: Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo looga hortagayo in horumariyeyaasha AI-da ee Shiinaha ay ka baxsadaan xakamaynta dhoofinta iyagoo si fog u adeegsanaya xarumo xog oo ku yaal dalal saddexaad, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Maxkamad Ireland oo xabsi daa'in ku xukuntay ninkii carruurta mindi ku weeraray Dublin 2023
item.description: Riad Bouchaker, oo 52 jir ah, ayaa Isniintii xabsi daa'in lagu xukumay isku day dil oo uu u geystay saddex carruur ah, weerar mindi ah oo 23 November 2023 ka dhacay meel u dhow dugsi ku yaal bartamaha Dublin kuna dhaliyay rabshado iyo boob caasimadda Ireland, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
